name: Ironhorse Golf Club
reasons: holes not all mapped in OSM (hole method: v2+structure)
foot: Automatic page (not hand checked): course from OpenStreetMap, card from golfify, trees / long grass / water from the vision layer on USDA NAIP + USGS 3DEP lidar, OB inferred from the course outline and buildings. Solved tee sets: Black, Blue. See qa_report.md for the hole-by-hole checks.

review.why: hole 18: wrong routing; 1 more with a wrong tee or pick

1: Black tee is on OSM way/837929723, ref 'Driving Range Tee Box (Turf)' (the photo shows the striped range tee), 89 yds off the hole-1 boxes and 11 deg off line.
18: Built to hole 4's green (way/497967756), 1607 yds as a par 5. OSM has hole 18 as a par 4 (way/889405229, 469 yds).
